en.quote: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
en.riddle: What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
en.speaker: Rabshakeh

bonus_hint.quote: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.

he.quote: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם רַב שָׁקֵה אִמְרוּ־נָא אֶל־חִזְקִיָּהוּ כֹּֽה־אָמַר הַמֶּלֶךְ הַגָּדוֹל מֶלֶךְ אַשּׁוּר מָה הַבִּטָחוֹן הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בָּטָֽחְתָּ
he.speaker: רַב שָׁקֵה

bonus_hint.quote: וּגְבוּל יָם וְהָיָה לָכֶם הַיָּם הַגָּדוֹל וּגְבוּל זֶֽה־יִהְיֶה לָכֶם גְּבוּל יָֽם

en.4: And Rabshakeh said unto them, Say ye now to Hezekiah, Thus saith the great king, the king of Assyria, What confidence is this wherein thou trustest?
